text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Carmichael Avenue, between Kelso Avenue and Avenue Road. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Carmichael Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Carmichael Avenue, between Kelso Avenue and Avenue Road. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of two (2) speed humps on Carmichael Avenue, between Kelso Avenue and Avenue Road, generally as shown on Attachment 2, Drawing TC-509 dated April 2025, attached to the report (May 16, 2025), entitled "Traffic Calming (Speed Humps) - Carmichael Avenue", from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
